# Environment/Device?

## PC/Laptop:
If you are on a desktop device like a PC or Laptop, please try to complete the following information- however much you feel is appropriate

 - OS: [e.g. Windows 11]
 - Launcher: [e.g. Modrinth App, PrismLauncher]
 - Device "specs": [e.g. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, 16GB RAM, Intel Core i5-13400F]
 - Modpack: [e.g. Butterium, ButterFine, MCMake]
 - Resolution and GUI Scale: [e.g. 1920x1080:3] [GUI scale is not needed if we have screenshots]
 - Modpack version: [e.g. v1.0.2]

## Smartphone:
If you are on a Smartphone, please complete the following information (wherever possible)

 - Device: [e.g. Google Pixel 10, Samsung S25 Ultra]
 - OS: [e.g. Android 16, OneUI 8]
 - Modpack: [e.g. Butterium Mobile, Butterium, ButterFine]
 - Launcher: [e.g. Mojolauncher, Pojavlauncher]
